title: EcoFair: Energy-Efficient Inference Routing for Edge AI under Data Degradation
abstract: arXiv:2603.26483v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Medical edge-AI systems must operate under a difficult tension: delivering reliable diagnostic inference while running on devices with limited battery capacity, memory, and compute. In dermatology, this problem is amplified by real-world image degradation caused by smartphone capture, poor lighting, blur, compression, and heterogeneous edge sensors. To handle these degraded inputs, deploying a heavyweight model can improve reliability, but it rapidly increases the energy burden on resource-constrained devices. Conversely, always using a lightweight model saves energy but may be less reliable on ambiguous or degraded inputs. This paper introduces EcoFair, a vertically partitioned inference framework for dermatology classification in which image and tabular inputs remain local to edge clients while only learned modality-specific representations are transmitted for server-side fusion. translated_title: EcoFair：数据退化下面向边缘AI的能效推理路由
translated_abstract: 医疗边缘AI系统必须在一种困难的张力下运行：一方面要提供可靠的诊断推理，另一方面设备又受限于电池容量、内存和计算能力。在皮肤病学领域，这一问题因现实世界的图像退化而进一步加剧，包括智能手机拍摄、光线不足、模糊、压缩以及异构边缘传感器造成的影响。为处理这些退化输入，部署大型模型可以提高可靠性，但会迅速加重资源受限设备的能量负担；相反，始终使用轻量级模型虽然节省能量，但在模糊或退化的输入上可靠性可能较低。本文提出了EcoFair，一个面向皮肤病分类的垂直分区推理框架，其中图像和表格输入保留在边缘客户端本地，仅传输学习到的模态特定表示用于服务器端融合。EcoFair首先使用轻量级模型处理每个样本（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: EcoFair提出了一种垂直分区推理框架，让边缘设备保留原始图像和表格数据、仅传输轻量的模态特定表示进行服务器端融合，从而在数据退化场景下平衡皮肤病分类的能耗与诊断可靠性。
en_tdlr: EcoFair is a vertically partitioned inference framework for dermatology classification that keeps image and tabular data local to edge clients and transmits only lightweight modality-specific representations for server-side fusion, balancing energy efficiency and reliability under real-world data degradation.
